title: Verify TutoredMirrorWipeService fires on tutor resign/revoke in manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart and manage_tutors_screen_l1_test.dart

evidence.quote: testWidgets('confirming resignation calls ResignTutorGrantUseCase', ( ... verify(() => mockResignUseCase.call(...)).called(1);
testWidgets('confirming Revoke calls revokeTutorGrantUseCase with the grant', ( ... only verifies mockRevoke.call, no mirror/session assertion
const result = TutorGrantFailure(message: message, code: code);

why: Both the tutor-side resign flow and the parent-side revoke flow fire-and-forget (unawaited) a local Drift mirror wipe plus an active-session exit() callback as an explicit fix (comment tag R4-M3) after the grant use case succeeds. This is the same class of stale-local-data bug this codebase already shipped once and wrote a dedicated regression test for elsewhere (iter10_outgoing_grants_stale_cache_test.dart, DG-TUT-STALE-01) — yet repo-wide grep for wipeMirrorForGrant/buildTutoredMirrorWipeServiceFromWidget in test/features/tutoring returns zero matches. Neither test file verifies the Drift mirror row is actually removed, or that activeTutoredProfileSelectionProvider clears when the resigned/revoked grant is the active tutored session. A regression that silently drops the unawaited(...) call, or breaks the onWipe wiring, ships undetected.
recommendation: Seed an in-memory Drift mirror row for the grant (reusing the inMemoryDb()/_seedActiveMirror pattern from r3_shell_revocation_exit_test.dart), confirm resign/revoke, then assert the mirror row is gone; add a case where the wiped grant is the active tutored selection and assert the provider clears.
acceptance_criteria: manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart asserts the Drift tutored-mirror row for a resigned grant is deleted after confirming resignation
manage_tutors_screen_l1_test.dart asserts the same for a revoked grant
Both cover the case where the wiped grant is the active tutored session and assert activeTutoredProfileSelectionProvider becomes null
